cutoff_basis: Strictly more than half: floor(N/2)+1; proposed before results, not chosen from observed performance

A.name: Full pass
A.test: All 31 frozen held-out authorization behaviour cases pass every frozen condition; all 19 control drills pass; all limits held; receipts published; open verifier says PASS.

B.name: Strong partial
B.test: 16–30 cases pass every frozen condition; all 19 control drills pass; limits held; every failure has a judge receipt naming the redacted difference.

C.name: Early partial
C.test: 1–15 cases pass every frozen condition; all 19 control drills pass; limits held; failures recorded.

D.name: Clean stop
D.test: Nothing passes, or a limit/control stops the run as designed, with a receipt saying why; no failed-open control or integrity violation.

E.name: No run
E.test: The run never starts because freeze is missed, a no-go or a blocker; no overriding integrity/control failure.

F.name: Unexplained
F.test: A limit exceeded, answers exposed, a case or condition changed after freeze, missing evidence, failed-open control, or verifier disagreement: stop, investigate and publish.

what_it_proves: Retain the human-supplied 2 November A–F meanings; this version proposes corrected population, condition terminology and B/C boundary only.
activation: None. Both this schema and the catalogue proposal are non-production. PR521 currently requires bc_cutoff=10; any approved cutoff change requires separately reviewed code/boundary tests and a new approved dated executable rules version.
fallback: N=1 with B/C unavailable remains unapproved and cannot be selected automatically.
